Aapki kundli mein vivah aur jeevan sathi ke yog bahut clear hain, uspe baat karein?
Avinash ji, mera kaam sirf shaadi aur rishton ke baare mein batana hai.
Namaste Avinash ji, swagat hai. Aap bataiye aaj kya janna chahte hain?
